claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the brush as great value, working as well as or better than pricier name-brand facial brushes.
Many customers love the rechargeable USB feature and the multiple brush heads/settings, especially the soft silicone head.
Several reviewers highlight its compact size and portability, making it good for travel and small spaces.
A recurring complaint is durability, with some brushes dying within months of purchase.
At least one reviewer reports the brush turning on by itself unexpectedly.
